notes.title: Bug fixes and leaderboard resets (Ver 1.1.6)
notes.notes:
* Fixed an issue where if you quit Challenge Mode while the supply coins are appearing after killing demons or the koban reward is appearing in the jar, and then immediately start Challenge Mode again, Challenge Mode will start with some of the supply coins and jar reward still intact.

# We have reset the leaderboard due to this bug affecting the score. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for your understanding.
# The game will not match players with different versions.

notes.title: Bug fixes and leaderboard resets (Ver 1.1.4)
notes.notes:
* Fixed a problem where players could start Challenge Mode with various events still running if they tried again with Jackpot, Demon Slayer, Mini-Game, etc. occurring at the end of Challenge Mode.

* Fixed an issue where the board was not reset when retrying after ending challenge mode.

# The new ranking will start after the update is applied, because this fix affects the score of Challenge Mode.
# The game will not match players with different versions.

notes.title: Resetting the leaderboard due to a bug fix (Updated)
notes.notes:
On November 7, 2021, at 7:00 PST, an update will be released to fix the following issues and reset the leaderboard at the same time.

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

* Fixed a problem where, when a jackpot, demon extermination, or mini-game (hereafter referred to as "various events") occurred at the end of a challenge, the challenge would start with the various events carried over if the challenge was restarted.

* Fixed a problem where retrying at the end of a challenge would not reset the stage. (Added on 2021/11/6 5:06)

# The new leaderboard will be applied after the bug fix update is applied. This is a measure to prevent users play challenge mode in a situation where the problem occurs without applying the update to fix the problem.


[h3]Background of the Leaderboard Reset[/h3]

If you play Challenge Mode with this bug, you will be able to score more than usual. We have decided to reset the leaderboard because this situation is unfair to the users who are playing for the top ranking.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by the glitch and the resetting of the leaderboard.

notes.title: Update (Ver 1.0.20)
notes.notes:
* Upgrade level limit increased.

* Fixed an issue where the appearance rate of cherry blossom bonsai was incorrect.

* Fixed an issue where prizes would not appear correctly when there was only one type of prize remaining that had not reached the maximum number of prizes to be won.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

notes.title: Improved & Changes (Ver 1.0.19)
notes.notes:
* When reverting to normal background music, it now resumes from the previous playback position.

* Changed the amount of coins obtained when a player obtains souls to 20.

* Anti-cheat measures have been implemented.

* Added processing for resuming the leaderboard.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.14) #Update
notes.notes:
* Fixed a problem where co-op events would not end.

* Fixed an issue where multiple co-op events could occur simultaneously.

* Anti-cheat measures have been implemented.

* Fixed an issue with friend match keywords not being saved. (Add 2021/10/11 22:32)

notes.title: Fixed & Added (Version 1.0.6)
notes.notes:
* Fixes a problem that caused differences in movement speed and injection intervals depending on PC specs.
→ In order to make it possible to run the game with as low specs as possible, players with high performance PCs may experience slower performance after applying this update.

* Fixed the problem of not being able to get the coin that you hit on the bottle.

* Sticker have been added. (3 types)

# The game will not match players with different versions.
